components.heading: Removal when obsolete.
components.text: Any existing driveway approach built for a purpose other than its present intended use shall be closed and the parking, curb and gutter restored to its original conditions by the owner of the property for which the building permit is sought. (Ord. 18916 § 8, 6-26-07. Code 1995 § 130-162.)
